props.heading: Build Big with Bayzyl
props.body:
Bayzyl is a building toolkit for Minecraft. Type one command and a dome appears. Paint a forest with a brush. Copy a whole castle and stack ten more. Made a mess? Undo it.

The idea behind it: building clubs for libraries, schools and youth organisations, where Minecraft time becomes practice with coordinates, geometry and teamwork. Bayzyl itself stays free and open source.
